title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Lynn texted you right after the call. Would it be accurate to write the Tigers expect a Torkelson will get done
I am guessing you are ignoring me because you are sick of me firing shots. I don’t blame you. But if there is anything more than that, please let me know.

I try not to fire shots intentionally. All I ask is for you to get back to me. I understand you are busy but I try to be as non-evasive as possible. I also understand why you can’t disclose certain things to me but we’ve done this for 5 years and I’ve never burned you

If I come to you with info and it’s ignored and it breaks a week later, that irks me. If you were to say, “Yes Workman $1 mill but don’t put it out there yet because we have to sign other guys” you know I wouldn’t. If you were to say “No UDFA signings but we’re working on it” I would not bust your balls
